title: ToolGraph as a Q-Function for Test-Time Scaling of Tool-Use Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.20569v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tool-use agents must chain interdependent calls, yet which outputs satisfy which later inputs in a deployed catalog is not something a general-purpose language model reliably infers from tool descriptions alone. We compile that structure once into a reusable external representation. ToolGraph is a directed, weighted dependency graph over a tool catalog: parameter matching and interventional probes, which execute a candidate chain with and without its proposed predecessor, propose edges whose evidence is combined into an edge confidence. Prior work uses such graphs to retrieve tools, search for tool paths, or score the next call. We ask instead whether the same structure can supply a \emph{multi-step} value by composing graph paths into a goal-conditioned action value \(Q(s,a,g)\). We study three estimators (dynamic programming over entity sets, a GraphSAGE estimator distilled from it, and an LLM scorer conditioned on graph evidence) plus

translated_title: ToolGraph作为工具使用智能体测试时扩展的Q函数
translated_abstract: 工具使用智能体必须串联相互依赖的调用，然而在已部署的工具目录中，哪些输出能满足哪些后续输入，通用语言模型仅凭工具描述是无法可靠推断的。我们将这种结构一次性编译为可复用的外部表示。ToolGraph是工具目录之上的有向加权依赖图：通过参数匹配和干预式探测（分别在有和没有所提议前驱的情况下执行候选调用链）来提出边，并将相关证据组合成边置信度。先前的工作利用此类图来检索工具、搜索工具路径或为下一次调用评分。我们转而探究同一结构能否通过将图路径组合为目标条件动作价值函数Q(s,a,g)来提供多步价值。我们研究了三种估计器（基于实体集的动态规划、从其蒸馏得到的GraphSAGE估计器，以及以图证据为条件的LLM评分器）以及
tldr: 该论文提出将工具目录一次性编译为有向加权依赖图ToolGraph，并通过组合图路径构建目标条件Q函数Q(s,a,g)，为工具使用智能体提供可复用的多步价值估计，从而实现测试时扩展。
en_tdlr: This paper compiles a tool catalog once into ToolGraph, a directed weighted dependency graph, and composes graph paths into a goal-conditioned Q-function Q(s,a,g), providing reusable multi-step value estimates for test-time scaling of tool-use agents.
